dataset.name: Trillion Dollar Words
dataset.citation: Agam Shah, Suvan Paturi and Sudheer Chava. 2023. Trillion Dollar Words: A New Financial Dataset, Task & Market Analysis. ACL 2023. https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.368/

keyword.description: Hawkish and dovish term lists learned from each seed's TDW train split (log-odds z-scores, top_k by grouped 5-fold CV on train), with negation; +1/0/-1 per sentence.

statement.method: statement split into sentences; procedural ones dropped; the 3 seed lexicons vote
statement.model_version: keyword-lexicon-v1 (TDW train; top_k 20/10/30; vote); mean sentence score, thresholds +-0.15

statement_post_hoc.method: post hoc, designed after the pre-registered results were seen: the same sentence labels, aggregated in the rubric's decision order (the rate-move sentence's label if hawkish or dovish, else the mean score of the rate-guidance sentences cut at +-0.15, else neutral; balance-sheet and risk-language steps left out)
statement_post_hoc.model_version: keyword-lexicon-v1 (TDW train; top_k 20/10/30; vote); rubric-ordered (post hoc): rate-action sentence's label, else mean score of the rate-guidance sentences with thresholds +-0.15, else neutral

finbert.description: ProsusAI/finbert fine-tuned on each seed's TDW train split (10% of train held out for early stopping); p(hawkish) - p(dovish) per sentence.

statement.method: statement split into sentences; procedural ones dropped; mean probs of 3 seeds
statement.model_version: ProsusAI/finbert@0bc2ac1 + TDW fine-tune (seeds 5768/78516/944601; mean probs); mean sentence score, thresholds +-0.15

statement_post_hoc.method: post hoc, designed after the pre-registered results were seen: the same sentence labels, aggregated in the rubric's decision order (the rate-move sentence's label if hawkish or dovish, else the mean score of the rate-guidance sentences cut at +-0.15, else neutral; balance-sheet and risk-language steps left out)
statement_post_hoc.model_version: ProsusAI/finbert@0bc2ac1 + TDW fine-tune (seeds 5768/78516/944601; mean probs); rubric-ordered (post hoc): rate-action sentence's label, else mean score of the rate-guidance sentences with thresholds +-0.15, else neutral

llm_zero_shot.description: LLM with the labelling rubric as the task definition; sentences in numbered batches, statements judged whole.

llm_few_shot.description: As llm_zero_shot plus 4 labelled sentences per class from a TDW train split (never test sentences or gold statements).

statement.method: whole statement in one call; examples from TDW seed 5768's train split

cost.note: OpenAI usage of the calls that filled data/stance/cache (git-ignored), added up per step; a rerun served from the cache adds nothing. USD at $0.75 input / $0.075 cached input / $4.50 output per million tokens (third-party price lists, October 2026). Excludes the 8 development calls (about $0.025) made while writing the prompts.

statement_variants.pre_registered: The method fixed before any reference label existed. Every timeline, database and API default result is this variant.
statement_variants.post_hoc_rubric_ordered: post hoc, designed after the pre-registered results were seen: the same sentence labels, aggregated in the rubric's decision order (the rate-move sentence's label if hawkish or dovish, else the mean score of the rate-guidance sentences cut at +-0.15, else neutral; balance-sheet and risk-language steps left out).

statement_bootstrap.method: Percentile bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of the scored statements (sorted by doc_id, drawn with replacement; numpy default_rng seed 20261013), accuracy and macro-F1 recomputed on each; 95% intervals. Every row on the same statements sees the same resamples; a paired difference scores both rows on each resample. Statements are resampled as if independent, but consecutive statements are near-duplicates, so these intervals understate the uncertainty.

year_blocks.method: Sensitivity check: the same 10,000 resamples, but drawing whole calendar years of statements with replacement (as many draws as there are years) instead of single statements; numpy default_rng seed 20261013; 95% intervals.

statement_baselines.name: majority_class
statement_baselines.label: hawkish
statement_baselines.description: Always the most frequent reference label; no classifier.

statement_baselines.name: rate_move_rule
statement_baselines.description: Post hoc, no classifier: the verb of the statement's rate-action sentence decides a move (raise or increase hawkish, lower, reduce or cut dovish), anything else is neutral. What the post-hoc rows get from detecting the move alone.
